Incircle.description: Construct the incircle of a triangle from its three vertices.

signatures.text: Incircle(A: point, B: point, C: point)

reference.keywords: incenter inscribed circle 内切圆 内心

examples.note: Constructs the incircle of the existing triangle ABC.

Conic.description: Construct a conic from points or coefficients.

signatures.text: Conic(A: point, B: point, C: point, D: point, E: point)
signatures.note: Studio expands this five-point form to the native command.

signatures.text: Conic(a: number, b: number, c: number, d: number, e: number, f: number)
signatures.note: Coefficients define ax² + dxy + by² + ex + fy = −c.
The list contains the six coefficients a, b, c, d, e, f in that order.

Conic.dispatch: The Studio command bar also accepts five point or tangent-line constraints, including mixed constraints. Unmatched native forms use GeoGebra.

signatures.note: Selects an intersection by index for supported object types.
Finds an intersection numerically from an initial point.

signatures.text: Intersect(function1: function, function2: function, start: number, end: number)
signatures.note: Finds intersections numerically within an interval.

signatures.text: Intersect(curve1, curve2, parameter1: number, parameter2: number)
signatures.note: Finds an intersection numerically from initial curve parameters.

Intersect.dispatch: In the Studio command bar, four points use the extension for the supporting lines AB and CD. Other forms shown here use GeoGebra.

Centroid.description: Construct the centroid of a polygon.
Centroid.dispatch: The three-point form is a Studio extension. The polygon form uses GeoGebra.

signatures.text: Cubic(A: point, B: point, C: point, index: number)
signatures.note: Constructs a supported numbered triangle cubic.

Cubic.dispatch: The nine-point form is a Studio extension. The triangle-and-index form uses GeoGebra.

Polar.description: Construct the polar of a point or the pole of a line with respect to a conic.
Polar.dispatch: The conic forms use GeoGebra. The point-and-cubic form is a Studio extension.

signatures.text: TriangleCenter(A: point, B: point, C: point, index: number)
signatures.note: GeoGebra's native catalogue accepts numbers below 3054.

TriangleCenter.dispatch: In the Studio command bar, literal patched native IDs and supported higher IDs use site recipes. Unpatched native IDs and computed selectors use GeoGebra.

AffineRatio.description: Find the directed affine ratio of three collinear points.

signatures.text: AffineRatio(A: point, B: point, C: point)

Angle.description: Measure an angle or construct an angle from points, lines, vectors or another geometric object.

signatures.text: Angle(A: point, vertex: point, C: point)
Angle(A: point, vertex: point, angle: number)

AngleBisector.description: Construct an angle bisector from three points, or both bisectors of two lines.

signatures.text: AngleBisector(A: point, vertex: point, C: point)

signatures.note: Returns both angle bisectors of the two lines.

Arc.description: Construct an arc of a circle or ellipse between points or parameter values.

Area.description: Measure the area of a polygon or conic, or of a polygon defined by points.

signatures.text: Area(A: point, B: point, C: point, …)

Circle.description: Construct a circle from a center and radius, a center and point, or three points.

CircularArc.description: Construct a circular arc from its center, starting point and a point determining its end direction.

signatures.text: CircularArc(center: point, A: point, B: point)

CircularSector.description: Construct a circular sector from its center, starting point and a point determining its end direction.

signatures.text: CircularSector(center: point, A: point, B: point)

CircumcircularArc.description: Construct the circular arc through three points.

signatures.text: CircumcircularArc(A: point, B: point, C: point)

CircumcircularSector.description: Construct the circular sector whose arc passes through three points.

signatures.text: CircumcircularSector(A: point, B: point, C: point)

Circumference.description: Measure the circumference of a circle or ellipse.

CrossRatio.description: Calculate the cross ratio of four collinear points.

signatures.text: CrossRatio(A: point, B: point, C: point, D: point)

Difference.description: Construct the region of one polygon outside another polygon.

Direction.description: Find a direction vector of a line.

Distance.description: Measure the distance between a point and an object, or between two lines.

Envelope.description: Construct the envelope of a path depending on a point.

InteriorAngles.description: Construct the interior angles of a polygon.

IntersectPath.description: Construct the intersection region of a line and polygon, or of two polygons.

Length.description: Find the length of an object or the arc length of a function or curve over an interval.

signatures.text: Length(function: function, start: number, end: number)
Length(function: function, start: point, end: point)

Line.description: Construct a line through two points, parallel to a line, or with a given direction vector.

Locus.description: Construct the locus traced by a dependent point as another point or slider moves.

Midpoint.description: Construct the midpoint of two points, a segment or an interval, or the center of a conic.

Perimeter.description: Measure the perimeter of a polygon or conic, or the length of a locus.

PerpendicularBisector.description: Construct the perpendicular bisector of a segment or of two points.

PerpendicularLine.description: Construct a line through a point perpendicular to a line, segment or vector.

Point.description: Construct a point on a path, translate a point by a vector, or convert coordinates from a list.

Polygon.description: Construct a polygon from points, a list of points, or two vertices and a vertex count.

signatures.text: Polygon(A: point, B: point, C: point, …)
Polygon(A: point, B: point, vertices: number)

Polyline.description: Construct a polyline through the supplied points.

Radius.description: Get the radius of a conic when defined.

Ray.description: Construct a ray from a starting point through a point or in a vector direction.

RigidPolygon.description: Construct a polygon whose shape remains rigid when moved.

signatures.text: RigidPolygon(A: point, B: point, C: point, …)

Sector.description: Construct a conic sector between points or parameter values.

signatures.text: Sector(conic: conic, A: point, B: point)
Sector(conic: conic, start: number, end: number)

Segment.description: Construct a segment between two points or from a point with a given length.

Semicircle.description: Construct a semicircle with the segment between two points as diameter.

Slope.description: Find the slope of a line.

Tangent.description: Construct tangents to conics, functions and curves using a point, a line or other supported inputs.

TriangleCurve.description: Construct a triangle curve from an equation in the barycentric variables A, B and C.

signatures.text: TriangleCurve(P: point, Q: point, R: point, equation)

Trilinear.description: Construct a point with specified trilinear coordinates relative to a triangle.

signatures.text: Trilinear(A: point, B: point, C: point, x: number, y: number, z: number)

Union.description: Construct the union of two lists or two polygons.

Type.description: Get the numeric type code of a conic.

Vertex.description: Construct vertices of a conic, polygon, segment or inequality.

Axes.description: Construct the axes of a conic.

Center.description: Construct the center of a conic.

Coefficients.description: Get the coefficients of a polynomial or conic.

ConjugateDiameter.description: Construct the diameter of a conic conjugate to a line or vector direction.

Curvature.description: Find the curvature of a function, curve or conic at a point.

Directrix.description: Construct the directrix of a conic.

Eccentricity.description: Get the eccentricity of a conic.

Ellipse.description: Construct an ellipse from its foci and an axis length, segment or point.

signatures.text: Ellipse(F1: point, F2: point, semiMajorAxis: number)
Ellipse(F1: point, F2: point, segment: segment)
Ellipse(F1: point, F2: point, P: point)

Focus.description: Construct the focus or foci of a conic.

Hyperbola.description: Construct a hyperbola from its foci and an axis length, segment or point.

signatures.text: Hyperbola(F1: point, F2: point, semiMajorAxis: number)
Hyperbola(F1: point, F2: point, segment: segment)
Hyperbola(F1: point, F2: point, P: point)

LinearEccentricity.description: Get the linear eccentricity of a conic.

MajorAxis.description: Construct the major axis of a conic.

MinorAxis.description: Construct the minor axis of a conic.

OsculatingCircle.description: Construct the osculating circle of a function, curve or supported object at a point.

Parabola.description: Construct a parabola from its focus and directrix.

Parameter.description: Get the distance between the focus and directrix of a parabola.

SemiMajorAxisLength.description: Get the semi-major axis length of a conic.

SemiMinorAxisLength.description: Get the semi-minor axis length of a conic.
